title: 5-Time WWE Women's Champion React To Time On Masked Singer And Shares A Health Update [Watch]
htmlContent:
Alexa Bliss appeared in the latest installment of The Masked Singer on March 22, 2023.

The WWE star turned out to be the person who wore the Axolot mask in the March 22nd episode. She commented on the news on the tweet and said that it was an extraordinary experience. Bliss also expressed appreciation to WWE and The Masked Singer.

"It was me behind the #AxolotlMask!What an amazing experience! Thank you to WWE & Masked Singer ."

Bliss has been away from WWE since losing to RAW champion Bianca Belair at WWE Royal Rumble. According to reports, she was on break before the five-time women's champion denied them. Bliss has been active on social media, providing various updates on itself.

She recently announced that she was "all clear" following the removal of some skin cancer.

There was a spot on my face yes- that had gotten worse. So went to get biopsy. Was basal cell carcinoma. During my procedure doc also found other squamous cells. Was a quick and easy procedure. Glad I always get my skin checked

The last one was about a facial surgery she went through recently. Miss Bliss took to her Instagram story to uncover its effects. The treatment helped remove the tanned patches on her face.

Bliss even left a "message" to herself when she was younger, claiming she should have stayed off the tanning beds. She also expressed her appreciation for the American Skin Institute' in her IG story.

“Dear younger me, you should have stayed out of tanning beds. All clear now though! Thank you @americanskininstitute for taking great care of me,” wrote Alexa Bliss.

"Thank you! Don’t worry, short healing time. Always get your skin checked! Esp if you are in the sun or use tanning beds! Lol," she tweeted.
